import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    orders = db["orders"]
    items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # Orders placed strictly before seed_time (no leakage: purchase moment is known)
    valid_orders = orders.loc[
        orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time, "order_id"
    ]
    valid_order_ids = set(valid_orders.unique())

    # --------------------------
    # 1. Order items features (ts = purchase moment, safe if < seed_time)
    # --------------------------
    foi = items[
        items["ts"].notna()
        & (items["ts"] < seed_time)
        & items["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids)
    ].copy()

    sales_agg = foi.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        first_sale_ts=("ts", "min"),
        last_sale_ts=("ts", "max"),
    ).reset_index()

    sales_agg["days_since_first_sale"] = (seed_time - sales_agg["first_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    sales_agg["days_since_last_sale"] = (seed_time - sales_agg["last_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    sales_agg = sales_agg.drop(columns=["first_sale_ts", "last_sale_ts"])

    for col_name, days in [("orders_30d", 30), ("orders_60d", 60), ("orders_90d", 90),
                           ("orders_180d", 180), ("orders_365d", 365)]:
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
        w = foi[foi["ts"] >= cutoff].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
        sales_agg[col_name] = sales_agg["product_id"].map(w).fillna(0)

    sales_agg["ratio_30_to_90"] = sales_agg["orders_30d"] / (sales_agg["orders_90d"] + 1e-9)
    sales_agg["ratio_60_to_90"] = sales_agg["orders_60d"] / (sales_agg["orders_90d"] + 1e-9)
    sales_agg["ratio_90_to_365"] = sales_agg["orders_90d"] / (sales_agg["orders_365d"] + 1e-9)

    # --------------------------
    # 2. Review features (only reviews already created before seed_time)
    # --------------------------
    fr = reviews[
        reviews["review_creation_date"].notna()
        & (reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time)
        & reviews["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids)
    ]
    review_product = fr[["order_id", "review_id", "review_score"]].merge(
        foi[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates("order_id"),
        on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    review_agg = review_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("review_id", "nunique"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        std_review_score=("review_score", "std"),
        min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
    ).reset_index()

    # --------------------------
    # 3. Payment features (only payments recorded before seed_time)
    # --------------------------
    fp = payments[
        payments["ts"].notna()
        & (payments["ts"] < seed_time)
        & payments["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids)
    ]
    payment_product = fp.merge(
        foi[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates("order_id"),
        on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    payment_agg = payment_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_payments=("payment_sequential", "count"),
        avg_payment_value=("payment_value", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()
    # share of orders paid by credit card (numeric, no categorical leakage issues)
    cc = payment_product.assign(is_cc=(payment_product["payment_type"] == "credit_card").astype(float))
    cc_share = cc.groupby("product_id")["is_cc"].mean().rename("credit_card_share").reset_index()
    payment_agg = payment_agg.merge(cc_share, on="product_id", how="left")

    # --------------------------
    # 4. Delivery features (only orders already delivered before seed_time)
    # --------------------------
    fo = orders[orders["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids)].copy()
    delivered = fo[
        fo["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()
        & (fo["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)
    ][["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp", "order_delivered_customer_date",
       "order_estimated_delivery_date"]]

    delivered_product = delivered.merge(
        foi[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates("order_id"),
        on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    delivered_product["purchase_to_customer_days"] = (
        delivered_product["order_delivered_customer_date"]
        - delivered_product["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
    delivered_product["estimated_vs_actual_days"] = (
        delivered_product["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
        - delivered_product["order_delivered_customer_date"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0

    delivery_agg = delivered_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_purchase_to_customer_days=("purchase_to_customer_days", "mean"),
        avg_estimated_vs_actual_days=("estimated_vs_actual_days", "mean"),
        n_delivered_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        on_time_delivery_rate=("estimated_vs_actual_days", lambda x: (x >= 0).mean()),
    ).reset_index()

    # --------------------------
    # 5. Merge
    # --------------------------
    result = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": entity_ids}).set_index("product_id")
    for agg_df in [sales_agg, review_agg, payment_agg, delivery_agg]:
        result = result.join(agg_df.set_index("product_id"), how="left")

    # --------------------------
    # 6. Imputation
    # --------------------------
    count_cols = ["total_orders", "total_items", "total_revenue", "total_freight",
                  "unique_sellers", "orders_30d", "orders_60d", "orders_90d",
                  "orders_180d", "orders_365d", "total_reviews", "total_payments",
                  "n_delivered_orders"]
    result[count_cols] = result[count_cols].fillna(0)

    avg_cols = ["avg_price", "std_price", "avg_freight", "avg_review_score",
                "std_review_score", "min_review_score", "avg_payment_value",
                "avg_installments", "credit_card_share",
                "avg_purchase_to_customer_days", "avg_estimated_vs_actual_days",
                "on_time_delivery_rate", "ratio_30_to_90", "ratio_60_to_90",
                "ratio_90_to_365"]
    result[avg_cols] = result[avg_cols].fillna(0)

    max_recency_days = (seed_time - pd.Timestamp("2016-01-01")).days
    result[["days_since_first_sale", "days_since_last_sale"]] = (
        result[["days_since_first_sale", "days_since_last_sale"]].fillna(max_recency_days)
    )

    # --------------------------
    # 7. Derived features
    # --------------------------
    result["has_sales_history"] = (result["total_orders"] > 0).astype(int)
    result["recency_score"] = 1.0 / (result["days_since_last_sale"] + 1.0)
    result["frequency_score"] = result["total_orders"] / (result["days_since_first_sale"] + 1.0) * 30.0
    result["monetary_score"] = result["total_revenue"] / (result["total_orders"] + 1.0)
    result["review_rate"] = result["total_reviews"] / (result["total_orders"] + 1.0)

    result = result.astype(float)
    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)
    return result
